item.description:
Xandro Essential+ is a science-backed daily multivitamin and mineral formula designed for superior absorption and long-term health support. Unlike generic multivitamins, Essential+ uses activated, methylated vitamins and clinically-validated mineral chelates to maximize bioavailability and efficacy—addressing common absorption issues linked to genetic variations such as MTHFR (affecting ~40% of the population).

The formula is intentionally free of herbal extracts, fillers, and non-essential additives, focusing on clinically validated, bioactive nutrients that the body can readily use. It is also vegan-friendly, with plant-based vitamin D3, methyl B12, and seaweed-derived calcium.

Key Product Benefits
Superior Absorption: Uses methylated B vitamins (e.g., 5-MTHF folate, methylcobalamin) that are the active forms your body can immediately utilize, bypassing conversion inefficiencies.
Comprehensive Nutrient Support: Covers essential vitamins and trace minerals for energy production, cognitive function, immune health, heart health, and cell regeneration.
Clean & Pure Formula: No herbal extracts or unnecessary ingredients that may cause sensitivities; ideal for those seeking a minimalist, high-efficacy daily multivitamin.
Vegan Ingredients: Includes bioavailable seaweed calcium and vegan vitamin D3/B12.
Quality Assured: Manufactured in GMP & HACCP-certified facilities and independently third-party tested for purity, heavy metals, microbes, and disintegration.

Usage Instructions
Take 1 tablet daily with water, with or after food.
Can be combined with other Xandro products like Protocol X or Joint Recovery without risk of overlapping active ingredients.
